summary: Image previews from chat links now really show on top of the chat, and Ctrl only offers a next image when there is another one.

changes.title: Chat image previews show on top of the chat
points: With chat open, the preview of an image link is drawn over the chat lines instead of behind them.
A long link that wraps over several lines counts as one image, so "1/2 Ctrl: next" no longer shows for a single picture.
Links that fail to load are skipped while another image on the line works.
